This artificial Christmas tree brings rich woodland charm to your home with a wide silhouette packed with 2843 branch tips. It arrives pre-decorated with pine cones and red berries, offering an instant festive look without the need for additional ornaments.

The outer branches feature individually moulded polyethylene tips that mimic the soft feel and organic growth of real forest foliage. These are blended with dense PVC inner branch tips to create incredible depth and fullness throughout the tree structure.

Designed with a pre-attached hinge mechanism, the branches fall into place automatically to significantly reduce setup time. You can enjoy more time celebrating the holidays rather than spending hours assembling your decoration, with suggested shaping taking only thirty to fifty minutes.

Celebrate the festive season with complete peace of mind thanks to flame-retardant branch tips supported by a strong metal base. This combination delivers reliable fire safety and stability for cosy winter gatherings involving young children or pets. The robust construction ensures the tree remains upright and secure, providing a safe environment for all household members.

This versatile seasonal accent smoothly infuses an authentic forest touch into living rooms, office displays, or holiday gatherings. It blends seamlessly with existing festive decorations while maintaining its vibrant holiday atmosphere throughout the celebration period.

Create a focal point
Use the decoration to draw attention to a chosen part of your arrangement. Giving it a little space around neighbouring pieces helps its outline and detail remain visible, whether it is displayed on its own or as part of a coordinated group.

Coordinate colour and texture
Pair the stated colour and material with accents already present in the room. Repeating a colour across a few carefully chosen accessories can bring the arrangement together, while contrasting textures add interest without requiring a complete change of decor.

Style around the occasion
A decorative accessory can help mark an occasion or refresh an established display. Arrange it with pieces of different heights or forms, keeping the overall grouping proportionate to the available space and the setting in which it will be viewed.

Plan the display
Choose a suitable support or display position for the size and form of the product. Allow enough space around it for the room to remain practical, and use the stated indoor or outdoor suitability when deciding where it should be placed.

Bring festive grandeur to high-ceilinged rooms with the Pre-Lit 10ft Fraser Fir Artificial Christmas Tree. Ideal for spacious homes, entrance halls, and lobbies, its towering height and traditional silhouette create a spectacular centrepiece.

Give your project a focus

Explore your own arrangement
Use the stated colours, shapes or materials as a starting point for your design. Trying an arrangement before attaching or finishing the pieces gives you room to adjust the composition and decide how the details will work together.

Keep the workspace clear
Group the supplies by type and leave enough working space for the project itself. Keeping small components in a defined area makes them easier to find and allows you to return to the project without rearranging everything from the beginning.

Work at your own pace

Coordinate with other supplies

Keep track of the pieces
Count and arrange the contents at the start of a project so you can plan their use. Keep unused pieces together between sessions and store them in a suitable place where their shape and finish will be maintained.

Christmas Decoration
This Christmas decoration adds a festive detail to your Christmas display.

Create a focal point
Use the decoration to draw attention to a chosen part of your arrangement. Giving it a little space around neighbouring pieces helps its outline and detail remain visible, whether it is displayed on its own or as part of a coordinated group.

Coordinate colour and texture
Pair the stated colour and material with accents already present in the room. Repeating a colour across a few carefully chosen accessories can bring the arrangement together, while contrasting textures add interest without requiring a complete change of decor.

Style around the occasion
A decorative accessory can help mark an occasion or refresh an established display. Arrange it with pieces of different heights or forms, keeping the overall grouping proportionate to the available space and the setting in which it will be viewed.

Give the detail room to show
Consider the background as well as the decoration itself. A simpler surrounding arrangement can make smaller details easier to appreciate, and a position away from visual clutter helps the chosen design remain the focus of the display.

A flexible finishing touch
Move the decoration within its intended setting when you want to change the look of an arrangement. Small adjustments to spacing and neighbouring colours can give familiar accessories a different presentation without adding more pieces.

Plan the display
Choose a suitable support or display position for the size and form of the product. Allow enough space around it for the room to remain practical, and use the stated indoor or outdoor suitability when deciding where it should be placed.

Christmas Wreath
This Christmas wreath adds a festive detail to your Christmas display.

Father Christmas Motif
A Father Christmas motif gives the design a recognisable festive character. It brings a seasonal focal point to the arrangement and can be paired with other Christmas decorations to create a consistent theme across the display.

Lightweight Design
The lightweight form is convenient to handle and move between suitable locations. It also makes the item easier to include when organising a bag or storage space.

Create a focal point
Use the decoration to draw attention to a chosen part of your arrangement. Giving it a little space around neighbouring pieces helps its outline and detail remain visible, whether it is displayed on its own or as part of a coordinated group.

Style around the occasion
A decorative accessory can help mark an occasion or refresh an established display. Arrange it with pieces of different heights or forms, keeping the overall grouping proportionate to the available space and the setting in which it will be viewed.

Give the detail room to show
Consider the background as well as the decoration itself. A simpler surrounding arrangement can make smaller details easier to appreciate, and a position away from visual clutter helps the chosen design remain the focus of the display.

Plan the display
Choose a suitable support or display position for the size and form of the product. Allow enough space around it for the room to remain practical, and use the stated indoor or outdoor suitability when deciding where it should be placed.

Care and presentation
Follow the care guidance for the stated material and handle decorative details gently. When the display changes, store the piece where its surface and shape will be supported, ready to bring out again for the next arrangement.

Includes three festive wreaths for versatile holiday decorating.
Features a recognisable Father Christmas motif design.
Lightweight construction allows easy handling and storage.
Fabric material provides a soft, traditional aesthetic.
Comes with 3 x Christmas Wreaths

5058194847074.sourceDescription:
Christmas Wreath
This Christmas wreath adds a festive detail to your Christmas display. The brown finish and polyester construction give it a defined appearance for Christmas at home.

Pine Cone Detail
Pine cone details add texture among the festive foliage. Their recognisable shapes help create a woodland inspired arrangement, making the decoration easy to coordinate with other natural looking Christmas accessories.

Water Resistant
The water resistant construction is useful where occasional moisture is part of the intended use. Allow damp surfaces to dry after use and follow the stated limits for exposure.

Reusable Design
The reusable format is intended to be used again after suitable care. Keep it clean and store it between uses so it remains ready for the next occasion.

Create a focal point
Use the decoration to draw attention to a chosen part of your arrangement. Giving it a little space around neighbouring pieces helps its outline and detail remain visible, whether it is displayed on its own or as part of a coordinated group.

Style around the occasion
A decorative accessory can help mark an occasion or refresh an established display. Arrange it with pieces of different heights or forms, keeping the overall grouping proportionate to the available space and the setting in which it will be viewed.

Give the detail room to show
Consider the background as well as the decoration itself. A simpler surrounding arrangement can make smaller details easier to appreciate, and a position away from visual clutter helps the chosen design remain the focus of the display.

Plan the display
Choose a suitable support or display position for the size and form of the product. Allow enough space around it for the room to remain practical, and use the stated indoor or outdoor suitability when deciding where it should be placed.

Product details
Material: Polyester. Colour: Brown. Product measurements: length 180 cm. Quantity: 1 piece.
Water resistant construction suitable for occasional moisture exposure.
Pine cone details add texture and a woodland inspired festive appearance.
Reusable design allows for storage and repeated use across seasons.
Brown polyester wreath with a defined look for Christmas at home.
Comes with 1 x Christmas Wreath

5056463974674.sourceDescription:
Create a welcoming seasonal display with this 55cm Battery Powered Christmas Door Wreath featuring warm LED lights, eight lighting modes and an automatic timer. The pre-assembled decoration combines rich green foliage with a traditional tartan bow, red poinsettia, festive baubles, berry clusters and pinecones for a classic Christmas appearance. Warm LEDs are integrated throughout the arrangement, highlighting the ornaments and creating an inviting glow during darker evenings. Choose from eight lighting effects, including steady, wave, sequential, slow glow, chasing flash, slow fade, twinkle flash and combination, allowing you to adjust the display to your preferred festive atmosphere. The built-in timer provides six hours of illumination followed by eighteen hours off, automatically repeating the cycle once activated. Measuring approximately 55 x 55 x 11cm, the wreath arrives ready to display and can be positioned on suitable doors, walls or other seasonal display areas. Powered by three AA batteries, it does not require a nearby mains socket. Batteries are not supplied.
8 FESTIVE LED LIGHTING MODES: Choose from combination, steady, wave, sequential, slow glow, chasing flash, slow fade and twinkle flash effects, allowing you to personalise the illuminated wreath to suit different Christmas decorating styles and occasions.
WARM LED CHRISTMAS ILLUMINATION: Integrated warm LEDs are positioned throughout the rich green foliage to create a soft welcoming glow, highlighting the decorative ornaments and adding seasonal atmosphere to suitable indoor festive displays.
AUTOMATIC 6H ON 18H OFF TIMER: Convenient built-in timer keeps the LED lights illuminated for six hours before switching them off for eighteen hours, then repeats the cycle automatically to simplify everyday Christmas lighting routines.
TRADITIONAL TARTAN & FESTIVE DECORATIONS: Features a decorative tartan bow, red poinsettia, baubles, berry clusters and pinecones arranged amongst full green foliage, creating a classic Christmas appearance with attractive seasonal textures.
PRE-ASSEMBLED 55CM BATTERY WREATH: Measures approximately 55 x 55 x 11cm and arrives ready for display. Operates using three AA batteries for convenient cable-free positioning on suitable doors, walls and indoor festive areas. Batteries are not included.

Flexible Shaping
The flexible construction lets you arrange the decorative sections to suit the available display space. Shape the parts gently as directed to create the outline you want, whether the piece is shown alone or within a larger seasonal grouping.

Create a focal point
Use the decoration to draw attention to a chosen part of your arrangement. Giving it a little space around neighbouring pieces helps its outline and detail remain visible, whether it is displayed on its own or as part of a coordinated group.

Style around the occasion
A decorative accessory can help mark an occasion or refresh an established display. Arrange it with pieces of different heights or forms, keeping the overall grouping proportionate to the available space and the setting in which it will be viewed.

Give the detail room to show
Consider the background as well as the decoration itself. A simpler surrounding arrangement can make smaller details easier to appreciate, and a position away from visual clutter helps the chosen design remain the focus of the display.

Plan the display
Choose a suitable support or display position for the size and form of the product. Allow enough space around it for the room to remain practical, and use the stated indoor or outdoor suitability when deciding where it should be placed.

Follow the care guidance for the stated material and handle decorative details gently. When the display changes, store the piece where its surface and shape will be supported, ready to bring out again for the next arrangement.

5051641498874.sourceDescription:
Hugely popular in America and increasingly loved in the UK, the Fraser Fir is chosen for its dense, bushy, silvery-green foliage and soft needles that are kind on hands when decorating. It gives off a sweet, citrusy scent that fills your home for as long as the tree is indoors, and its strong, upward-angled branches make decorating easy and hold heavier ornaments without trouble. Fraser Firs have excellent needle retention as long as they are kept well watered. Our trees are grown in the UK and freshly cut before dispatch. When your tree arrives, cut a few centimetres from the base of the trunk and stand it in water straight away. Keep it in a stand with a water reservoir, topped up every 1-2 days, and away from radiators and fires so it stays fresh throughout Christmas.
REAL FRESH CUT TREE - Add a traditional feel to your home this Christmas with a freshly cut, real Fraser Fir
PREMIUM QUALITY, FRESH FROM THE FARM - Our Christmas trees are grown in the UK, ensuring the highest growing standards, and cared for year round by our expert team
GREAT SHAPE & FRAGRANCE - The Fraser Fir owes much of its popularity to its strong base, thick branches and citrusy-sweet scent
STAND SOLD SEPARATELY - A stand with a water reservoir is vital for keeping your tree fresh. Pop your tree in, fill it with water and you're ready to decorate
CARE GUIDE SUPPLIED WITH EVERY TREE - Keep your tree in top condition with our free step-by-step care guide. This gives tips on prepping, watering and decorating your tree.
